evals.name: vietnamese-db-report-lualatex
evals.prompt: Convert our Vietnamese PTIT project report into a boxed PTIT PDF using LuaLaTeX without editing the Markdown headings manually. Fix tight bullet lists, render the wide 5-column table cleanly with breakable snake_case identifiers, merge the adjacent Vietnamese figure caption, and prove zero missing characters or LaTeX errors.
evals.expected_output: Compiled PDF with PTIT boxed Vietnamese cover, clean auto-numbered chapters and Phu luc A appendix, unbroken Vietnamese code comments inside Python/SQL blocks, adapted 5-col table, and verified JSON audit passing with 0 errors and 0 missing characters.
assertions: Report PDF compiles via LuaLaTeX with non-zero file size (>5KB)
Generated LaTeX strips manual '# 1.' prefix cleanly into '\chapter{Tổng quan kiến trúc}' and emits '\appendix'
Audit log JSON reports passed=true, 0 errors, and 0 missing_chars for Vietnamese glyphs and code comments
Adjacent caption '*Hình 1: Kiến trúc tổng thể*' becomes clean figure caption and table emits adaptive sizing

evals.name: multifile-en-citeproc-xelatex
evals.prompt: Assemble our multi-file English report chapters directory with refs.bib citations and compile with XeLaTeX into an English PDF using citeproc, boxed cover preset metadata, and a compact TOC.
evals.expected_output: Assembled Markdown without leaked chapter YAML headers, PDF built with XeLaTeX, resolved bibliography entries from refs.bib, compact TOC, and zero undefined references/citations.
assertions: Chapters assemble in deterministic numeric order without secondary YAML leaks
Generated LaTeX includes resolved CSLReferences citations for knuth1984 and vaswani2017
XeLaTeX compiles multi-pass PDF with compact TOC enabled and passed=true log audit

evals.name: pdflatex-legacy-verbatim-and-preflight-gate
evals.prompt: Compile our Vietnamese report containing UTF-8 Vietnamese comments inside fenced Python/SQL blocks using pdfLaTeX fallback mode safely, and separately verify that a Markdown document containing unrendered Mermaid fences and missing image paths is blocked before LaTeX runs.
evals.expected_output: pdfLaTeX succeeds using --code-verbatim (fvextra) with zero listings UTF-8 crash, while the broken Markdown report fails cleanly at preflight stage before invoking Pandoc or creating a PDF.
assertions: pdfLaTeX build succeeds with code-verbatim/fvextra fallback enabled and passed=true log audit
Preflight gate blocks sample-broken.md referencing raw mermaid fence and missing asset before generating any PDF
